$comment: Section 12 conformance matrix of the Originals Protocol, one entry per row, pinned to originals-spec a2b5013, master after #64 (EVM anchoring withdrawn, Bitcoin previews; merged as 55aefc4, the same table as 940c6d4) and #66 (signer sets, parent Originals and scoped grants; owner decisions of 19 November 2026, D8). At a2b5013 the table has 324 rows: rows 1 to 284 are those of 940c6d4 at the same positions, with no row reworded (C12-63 keeps its text, which P5.2 now reads for one signer reference; see its note), and the 40 rows #66 adds are new, C12-382 to C12-421 (rows 285 to 324: signer sets 285-300, parent Originals 301-314, scoped grants 315-324). Earlier: at 940c6d4 the 90 EVM rows were retired (C12-235 to C12-289, C12-292 to C12-296, C12-301, C12-310 to C12-315, C12-323 to C12-330, C12-334 to C12-342 and C12-349 to C12-354; see `retired`), 15 rows were reworded and kept their ids, and the 27 preview rows were new, C12-355 to C12-381. Each row is covered by a test that references its id, or stays status=todo. status=partial means some layers are tested and the note says what remains; coveredBy lists the citing test files (checked by packages/vh/tests/conformance/registry.test.ts). Phases follow spec section 10 and plans/011. status=not-applicable means an owner decision makes the row moot pending a spec edit; its note names the decision. Ids are stable across re-pins: position is the row's place in the pinned table. Pinned rows are in table order, positions 1 to N; rows from open pull requests follow them, and two pull requests can each propose a row at the same position. A proposal can also insert rows between pinned ones, and reword pinned rows, whose note then gives the proposed wording. A row with `proposal` is not in the pinned table: it comes from the named open spec pull request, is implemented provisionally, and its position is its place in that pull request's table. A row the pinned table no longer has is listed under `retired` with the commit and reason; its id is never reused, and no test cites it.
